description: This Java class calculates the number of payment periods in a year based on different frequency types and computes the portion of interest charging grace period for loan repayment schedules.

classes.name: DefaultPaymentPeriodsInOneYearCalculator
classes.description: Implements calculation of payment periods per year and interest charging grace periods based on repayment frequency types.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Returns the number of payment periods in one year based on the given repayment frequency type.

methods.name: calculatePortionOfRepaymentPeriodInterestChargingGrace
methods.description: Calculates the fraction of the repayment period during which interest is charged, considering grace periods.

methods.name: calculateRepaymentPeriodFraction
methods.description: Helper method to compute the fraction of the repayment period based on frequency type and days of interest calculation grace.
